title: Are You 'Most Done?
author: Russell Owen
notes: The Caller's Box 2842, permission: full. The Caller's Box's own notes: "Hey can straighten out as it proceeds. Dance begins with same neighbors as in the hey." **Still owed, measured.** The record resolves and dances; the oracles do not pass. At 4 couples: closure 60.0000 px, progressed 0.0000 px, reach 46.6301 px short. At 5 couples and above `long-lines` throws `station "1L" has no line mate` in the second time through, which is the same fault one cycle on: three of a minor set's four on one side of it. The one thing owed is **which four dancers a right-diagonal hey is with, and what it leaves behind**. Two readings, and no measurement here decided between them: the star left 7/8 leaves your own minor set standing on a diagonal and you hey with it (what this record writes — `axis: "diagonal"`, the lane at whatever angle the four really make, Q12's fixed diagonal), or the hey is with the couple across the seam (`"group": "shadow-pair"`, which becket already partitions, and which makes the hey the progression). The diagonal **lane** is built and tested either way (`hey.test.ts`). Lisa Greenleaf's alternate B2 (#4700) is in the transcript and is not encoded: it is the same concurrent call with a shoulder round and a shift.
